public_wrapper.scope: Fresh process import and own descriptor/module reads only. No QApplication, Qt object, image, model, device, target attach or trace.

loaded_stable_ABI_targets.scope: Own-process loaded IAT reads only. No error API invocation, Qt objects, QApplication, image, model, target attach, device or capture.

limits: The public native call has no explicit SaveThread bridge; the normal CPython method-entry GIL contract is a static mechanism constraint, not a direct historical owner snapshot.
Qt latch waits and consumer GIL waits are distinct Waiting paths. Ready-to-in is not counted as GIL Waiting.
A simultaneous scheduler intersection does not identify the GIL owner, wake source, same image job or root contribution.
No prior pending point is promoted to a QLabel witness unless its full clock bracket and guard match.
Old stack and actual-load3%/1% failures remain failed. No duration shares, CPU percentages or formal fix follow.

raw_manifest.reason: Keep all 26350 qualified consumer chains and full evidence locally; publish bounded derived witnesses without video, binaries or redundant full stacks.

selection: All timing references for every qualified GUI latch wait and every guarded intersection. Full-chain examples are the first by observed order per consumer GIL boundary, not selected for longest waits.
